Governing Features: Deliberately breaking physics-first Python API; unchanged Rust numerical contracts; fresh wheel-only agent evaluation with independent grading.

Hidden Behavior Changes — P1 [contract]: scripts/agent_eval/grade.py:169 writes .eval_replay.py through the unsandboxed parent into the agent-controlled workspace. An agent can create that filename as a symlink to any parent-writable external file; grading then overwrites the target, crossing the stated isolation boundary. The exporter’s three artifact-link checks do not cover this file. Pass replay code directly to the isolated interpreter or create it without following links.

No Findings: No additional evidence/intent mismatch found. Independently recomputed 624 attempts, 110→118 main passes, 316.39→229.72 minutes, and the reported 118-pair token totals. All 332 audit hashes match archived submissions; all passing derivative attempts have audits. Confirmation versus new transfer is correctly distinguished, and the missed 40% gate is explicit.

Read-only review; no tests, builds, writes, or Git mutations performed.
